title: Oven-Roasted Ethiopian Beef Misir-Wot
description: A light and flavorful Ethiopian dish featuring roasted beef, tomatoes, and spices. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Season the beef with berbere spice and mitmita.
Heat olive oil in the molcajete over medium-high heat. Sear the beef on all sides until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Remove the beef from the molcajete and set aside.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the molcajete and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes to the molcajete and stir to combine. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Return the beef to the molcajete and pour in enough water to cover the bottom. Cover the molcajete with a lid and transfer to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
Remove the molcajete from the oven and sprinkle the beef with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the roasted beef over the tomato mixture, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
